title: Biofermentor Virtual SC
description: Open, auditable virtual fermentation platform for Saccharomyces cerevisiae ethanol process-control studies. Version 3.0 separates growth-associated substrate demand from a bounded non-growth-associated fermentative catabolic flux under nitrogen limitation, with C/N/O2 integrity audits, sensitivity and practical-identifiability diagnostics, bounded parameter estimation, frozen-parameter independent-validation workflows, and a responsive Tkinter scientific interface. The new non-growth-associated catabolic parameters are phenomenological reference values and are not calibrated to a specific strain, medium, vessel or industrial process; this release does not claim quantitative experimental validation. Real-data calibration and the pending real Exp. 3 validation track remain intentionally out of scope for v3.0.0 and are reserved for a later release.
